_note: Admission documents checklist ([am_doc_checklist], inc/documents.php, page /guides/admission-documents-checklist/). Every item is paraphrased from the official prospectus/policy named in its university's source, with the printed page number in p. Fields: t text, st stage (apply = with the online application, join = when selected/joining), for = groups that need it (omit = everyone), p printed page, n note. Groups are the 'my case' ticks. Re-read when a new prospectus is out (UHS/KMU each autumn, UET/KU/COMSATS each summer) and bump checked.

groups.district: Under-developed, backward or tribal area seat
groups.overseas: Overseas Pakistani or parent working abroad
groups.special: Other reserved seat (employees' or alumni children, minorities, other provinces)

stages.join: When you are selected and join

universities.name: UHS Punjab: public MBBS and BDS
universities.source_label: UHS MBBS/BDS Prospectus, Session 2026-2027 (government medical and dental colleges of Punjab)
universities.dates: Applications, merit lists and joining dates: see the official schedule on the UHS admission page.
universities.intro: Everything is uploaded on the UHS portal: each file JPG or PNG, at most 500 KB, scanned from the original, both sides of a CNIC as separate files (p. 53).

items.t: Punjab domicile certificate
items.n: Not needed on overseas or dual-nationality seats. Under-developed district and Cholistan seats need that district's domicile; tribal-area seats need "Tribal Area" on it.

items.t: SSC and HSSC (Pre-Medical) result cards, photocopies verified by your board
IBCC equivalence certificate or provisional equivalence letter for 10th and 12th grade
If IBCC did not give "Pre-Medical" equivalence (Maths instead of Physics): board results showing you passed Biology and Chemistry in 11th/12th grade
Your identity document: CNIC, B-Form/CRC, Pakistan Origin Card or passport (not expired)
Identity document of your father, mother or guardian
Iqama, residence permit, Green Card, Maple Card or foreign passport
items.n: Saudi Arabia: add a screenshot from Absher or the MOI website showing the expiry date.

items.t: Education Verification Certificate (UHS template) signed by every school and college from class 1 to 12, verified by the CEO (DEA) and Director of Education (Colleges), attested by the Deputy Commissioner, plus School Leaving/Character/Provisional certificates
Cholistan seat: Cholistan Development Authority certificate (UHS template)
Disability certificate from NCRDP or the Provincial/District Social Welfare Department (a UHS Medical Board then examines you)
Students of other provinces/regions on their reserved seats: domicile of that province or region
Colour photograph, white background, not older than one month, face fully visible
Signature in blue ink on white paper with your left thumbprint (photographed)
Paid Rs 2,000 application fee challan (BOP or NBP, or 1Bill invoice)
College fee paid within three working days of the selection list, and the paid challan uploaded on the portal
Joining report signed and stamped by the college, uploaded on the UHS portal
All original documents plus attested copies, deposited with the college at the interview (kept until you finish MBBS/BDS)
Surety bond of Rs 3 million to serve the Punjab Government for one year after house job
Certificates of typhoid (enteric) inoculation within 12 months, full tetanus and full hepatitis B vaccination
HIV status certificate from a prescribed laboratory in Pakistan
IBCC attestation of your educational documents after joining (not needed at application)
A parent or legal guardian comes with you at joining

universities.name: KMU Khyber Pakhtunkhwa: public MBBS and BDS
universities.source_label: KMU Admission Policy 2025-26, public sector medical and dental colleges of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
universities.dates: The 2026-27 policy was not online when this list was checked: the documents rarely change, but confirm with the new policy.
universities.intro: Scanned copies of all certificates go with the online form; selected students bring every original to the interview and the college keeps them until you leave (p. 26).

items.t: Detailed Marks Certificates of every examination your admission is based on
IBCC equivalence certificate (foreign education system)
Valid Khyber Pakhtunkhwa/Merged Districts domicile of you and your father
Death certificate of your father plus your mother's domicile
Your CNIC or NADRA Form-B
Your father's CNIC (if he is not alive, your mother's or guardian's)
Disability certificate from the Social Welfare Department KP, disability medical certificate on the prescribed proforma, and Form-B/CNIC with the disability logo
Parent's valid OPF membership card and Foreign Exchange Remittance Card
Location certificate of your schools/colleges from their heads, countersigned by the DEO and DC
KMU wards: service certificate from the KMU establishment section
Certificate from the institution you last attended, with your duration of stay (and one naming both institutions if FSc Part-I and Part-II were in different places)
Migration certificate from your board, submitted at the college that admits you
All original certificates at the interview/admission

universities.name: UET Lahore: undergraduate engineering
universities.dates: Fall 2026 is over; the Fall 2027 dates come with the next prospectus (around June 2027).
universities.intro: The online form needs your result cards; dues and paper documents are submitted only after you are selected, at the designated centres at UET Lahore (p. 30).

items.t: Matriculation and Intermediate Part-I result cards (uploaded), or the Inter roll number if the result is awaited
O-Level candidate number and IBCC equivalence number and marks (original IBCC certificate needed from admitted students)
Tick Hafiz-e-Quran on the form and take the oral test before the Verification Committee (0 to 20 marks)
items.n: Fall 2026 test: Friday 17 July 2026, 10:00 am at UET Lahore; no call letters are sent.

items.t: Tick sports on the form (one sport) and take the sports test before the Verification Committee (up to 10 marks)
Category T: original disability certificate or CNIC
Category S: original Form F-VIII on your parent's job abroad and a copy of their resident visa attested by the Pakistan embassy (scans or faxes not accepted)
Category S, orphan: father's NADRA death certificate, CNICs of all family members with the NADRA Family Registration Certificate, and the Nikah Nama if the guardian is your maternal uncle

Category M: original Registrar certificate on Form-V and an unmarried undertaking on Form-VI; N: attested parent's degree and PEC/PCATP registration; O: parent's UET Lahore degree and PEC/PCATP registration
Paid original bank challan of university dues (keep photocopies)
Original certificates: Matric/O-Level, Intermediate/A-Level, DAE or B.Sc. Engineering Technology
Two sets of photocopies of every educational document, including the domicile
Four recent passport-size photographs
Two copies of your CNIC or B-Form
Bio-data card (Form-I), filled in completely
Medical certificate (Form-II) signed and stamped by a PMC-registered practitioner
Attested current income certificate of your parent or guardian
Undertaking (Form-VII) on Rs 100 judicial paper

Categories A1, A2, L, N, Q, R with Matric and Inter (or DAE) from outside Punjab/Islamabad: parent's Punjab/ICT domicile copy, Form-VI from the election officer, a copy of the electoral roll page with your parent's name, parent's CNIC copy and an undertaking on Form-VII
items.n: Parent in government service posted outside Punjab: Form-V from the head of department instead.

items.t: Proof of your father's death and of your parent's immovable property in Punjab or Islamabad (instead of the domicile papers above)

universities.name: UET Taxila: undergraduate engineering
universities.dates: Newest prospectus on the UET Taxila downloads page is 2025; check it again when the 2026-27 admissions open.
universities.intro: Attested photocopies are brought with the printout of the online Form F-I when you report for joining (p. 138).

items.t: Attested photocopy of your domicile certificate
Hafiz-e-Quran: fill the column in Form F-I and appear before the Verification Committee (Jamia Mosque Bilal, UET Taxila, on the notified date)
Printout of your online application Form F-I
CNIC or Form-B
SSC detailed marks certificate
FSc, DAE or B.Sc. certificate (board result card accepted; a provisional certificate is not)
Detailed marks certificate of the exam your admission is based on
Domicile certificate and entry test result
Certificate of additional Mathematics
Category J: certificate from Social Welfare/PCRDP, Government of Punjab or Federal Government
Categories Q1/Q2: certificate from the District Coordination Officer that you live in the tribal area
Category X: Form F-VIII from the Pakistani embassy on your parent's job abroad and their resident visa attested by the embassy

M: original Registrar certificate (Form F-IX); N: parent's degree and renewed PEC registration; O: parent's UET Taxila degree; R: minority undertaking on Rs 50 stamp paper attested by an Oath Commissioner; NCC: certificate from the DG National Cadet Corps for 20 marks

Studied outside Punjab/Islamabad (categories A, J, L, N, G, Q1, Q2, T): parent's attested domicile, Form F-III from the election officer, electoral roll page, parent's CNIC and an undertaking on Form F-IV
items.n: Parent in government service outside Punjab: Form F-II from the head of department.

items.t: Proof of your father's death and of your parent's immovable property in Punjab or Islamabad

universities.name: COMSATS (CUI): undergraduate programs
universities.dates: The 2024-25 prospectus is the newest one on the COMSATS site; the list has been the same for years.
universities.intro: Shortlisted candidates bring these to the campus admissions office for verification within the given time (p. 46).

items.t: Original Matric and Intermediate certificates/detailed marks sheets, with two attested photocopies of each
Original equivalence certificate with two attested photocopies
Original Hope Certificate with two attested photocopies, or an affidavit
Original migration certificate with two attested photocopies (if applicable)
Undertaking on stamp paper by you and your guardian (sample in the prospectus)
CNIC or B-Form with two attested photocopies
Two passport-size photographs attested on the back, with your name, guardian's name and program written behind each

universities.name: University of Karachi (KU): BS programs
universities.dates: Admission dates are announced on uok.edu.pk and in newspapers.
universities.intro: Students on the admission list must finish these formalities in the given time or the admission lapses (p. 24).

items.t: Change of category to K: parent's domicile and CNIC showing a Karachi address (and the other papers for your case)
Married to a permanent resident of Karachi: Nikah Nama with your spouse's domicile and CNIC
Special persons' seats: medical certificate from the Social Welfare Department Sindh or a civil surgeon
Sports seats: upload sports certificates and supporting documents
University employees' seats: statement of employment certified by the head of department
Coloured printout of the online Enrolment Form
Original HSC/Intermediate marks sheet (not returned)
Original character certificate from the head of your last institution (private candidates: from a gazetted officer)
One copy of your CNIC (under 18: your father's or mother's CNIC)
One copy each of your SSC/Matric/O-Level and HSC/Intermediate/A-Level certificates
Original payment receipt (enrolment copy) of the fee
Affidavit/undertaking in the given format (no political activity)
Migration certificate (last exam passed outside Karachi)
IBCC equivalence certificate (international students)
